text:
Alex R: Quick async check-in — onboarding cortado-7b for LATAM use. Quick bullets: 1) evals showing BLEU drop on es-qa promptset (sample attached), 2) quantization CI failing for q5_0 pipeline, 3) PR#4567 ready for review but small kv cache test flaky.

Maria G: Repro'd BLEU drop locally, looks like tokenizer change at step `tokenizer_v2`. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/evals/789 — check the 'es-qa' split. :eyes:

Jon P: I'll grab PR#4567 review today, can someone paste repro steps for the CI failure? @Sana K @Maria G

Sana K: Blocked on labelled devset for edge-case tokens (dates + abbreviations). I pushed a small script to fix normalization: `scripts/fix_spanish_norm.py` — run `python scripts/fix_spanish_norm.py --sample 200`. After that the minibatch test passes locally.

CI Bot: Build #5821 failed on quantize step.
```
ERROR: q5_0 conversion: unexpected dtype float16 -> abort
Traceback: ...
```

Alex R: Proposed short plan: a) pin tokenizer to `tokenizer_v1` in the rollout pool, b) revert quant profile to `quant_profile_v3` (stable), c) Sana — if you can run the fix script and post results we'll rerun evals. @Jon P — thanks for taking the PR review. :thumbsup:

Jon P: Ack — will review this afternoon, if kv-test flakes I'll add a focused unit test and ping for merge.

Maria G: If we pin tokenizer we should also add an eval gate to block automatic rollouts until BLEU >= baseline. I can add a quick checkpoint in the rollout config.

Alex R: Command to pin rollout variant (useful for quick rollback):
```
redwood rollout set-variant --model cortado-7b --variant tokenizer_v1 --scope rollout_pool_latam
```

Sana K: Ran `fix_spanish_norm.py` on 200 samples — minibatch tests + tokenizer sync passing locally. Uploading the updated devset to `gs://redwood-internal/devsets/es-edge/2026-03-18-01` now.

Maria G: Great — rerunning evals now, will post results in ~20m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Alex R: Thanks team — marking as async done. If BLEU still drops after rollback we will schedule a quick pairing session. /cc @ops-team for any infra issues.
